description: Equip your enterprise in Gaborone, Maun, and beyond with 24/7 cloud AI bots. Automate safari bookings, mining logistics, and digital workflows effortlessly.
h1: Empower Botswana Business With Dedicated AI Agents
sub: Deploy persistent AI agents operating 24/7 in dedicated cloud environments to manage research, client communications, and workflows across southern Africa.
audience: Safari operators in Maun, mining supply vendors in Gaborone, cross-border logistics directors in Francistown, commercial cattle farm managers, and regional tech founders.
manifesto: In a dynamic economy spanning the Kalahari to the Gaborone CBD, Ceyo gives Batswana enterprises relentless autonomous computing power that executes complex operations uninterrupted, even when power fluctuates or your mobile devices go offline.

uses.d: Connect bots to your Gmail and booking calendars to answer international safari inquiries, confirm lodge availability in the Okavango Delta, and update guest itineraries around the clock.
Task your bot's autonomous browser to monitor public procurement portals, compile equipment specifications, and structure quotation sheets in Google Sheets automatically.
Track regional shipments along the Trans-Kalahari corridor, parsing bills of lading and syncing customs documentation with your logistics team in real time.
Schedule autonomous browser routines to monitor regional feed auctions, livestock market pricing, and veterinary supply indices, delivering weekly summaries straight to Telegram.
Deploy long-memory research agents to cross-reference corporate filing documents, summarize statutory guidelines, and build structured dossiers for client advisory meetings.
Enable your technical team to draft, run, and unit-test internal software applications directly inside an isolated cloud computer without depleting local office hardware.

steps.d: Select your preferred subscription plan and configure your dedicated cloud environment during the three-day free trial.
Link Telegram, Google Workspace, CRM records, and over one thousand supported operational applications.
Delegate web research, live document syncs, and automated workflows to run continuously 24/7.

chapters.d: Your cloud bot compiles European safari inquiries and overnight supplier updates into a clean Telegram memo before you arrive at your office in Gaborone. It has already updated reservation sheets and drafted customized responses for review.

While you meet with business partners in the CBD, your bot navigates regional commodity portals to evaluate heavy equipment prices. It extracts technical datasheets, converts foreign currency quotes, and structures an evaluation sheet.

Your technical bot writes and tests an API sync script inside its isolated cloud computer while your administrative bot alerts logistics staff in Francistown. Both bots share project memory inside a single Telegram group chat seamlessly.

Even after you disconnect your laptop and switch off your smartphone, your cloud environment continues processing scheduled database backups and deep market reports. Operations persist without interruption until tomorrow's dawn.

faq.q: What are the subscription plans and trial terms for Ceyo?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily; a card is linked upon registration and is only charged once the trial concludes unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Does my bot stop working if my local internet or power disconnects?
faq.a: No, each Ceyo bot runs inside its own dedicated cloud virtual computer independent of your physical device. Even if your phone battery dies or local power networks drop, your agents continue running scheduled browser tasks, code executions, and integrations 24/7.

faq.q: Can I manage my AI agents through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can interact with Ceyo bots directly via private Telegram messages or invite multiple specialized bots into Telegram group chats. This allows your team members to collaborate alongside AI agents that share context, project files, and long-term memory.

faq.q: Which languages can Ceyo bots read, write, and process?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates fluently in English, Setswana, and dozens of international languages. Your bots can translate international traveler inquiries into English, read technical documents in various languages, and respond naturally across platforms.

faq.q: How do Ceyo bots access external business applications?
faq.a: Ceyo natively integrates with over 1,000 workplace tools including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading CRMs. Additionally, bots can independently operate a built-in web browser to interact with web portals that lack direct API connections.
